extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policy analysts, journalists, and general readers seeking country reference data
extracted.subtask_description: A tabular/reference dataset listing per-country economic-sector percentages (agriculture / industry / services) and counts of broadcast stations (AM, FM, shortwave, television), with estimate years and qualifying notes.

rubrics_metrics.name: agriculture (percentage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines formatted like 'agriculture: 8.7%' or 'agriculture: NA' with an estimate year in parentheses on some lines (e.g., '(2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents the agriculture percentage value reported for the country (page uses percent notation). The adjacent parenthetical year (e.g., '(2003 est.)', '(2004 est.)') is the estimate year. 'NA' indicates not available. Example: 'Ecuador  agriculture: 8.7% (2003 est.)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: industry (percentage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines formatted like 'industry: 29.7%' or 'industry: NA' with an estimate year in parentheses on some lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents the industry percentage value reported for the country. The parenthetical year on the same line is the estimate year. Values sometimes accompanied by notes (e.g., 'includes fishing 12%'). Example: 'Iceland  industry: 26.7% (2003 est.)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: services (percentage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines formatted like 'services: 61.6%' or 'services: NA' with an estimate year in parentheses on some lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Represents the services percentage value reported for the country. Parenthetical years indicate the estimate year. Some entries include clarifying notes (e.g., 'includes West Bank'). Example: 'Ecuador  services: 61.6% (2003 est.)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: estimate_year / year_qualifier
rubrics_metrics.description: Parenthetical year qualifiers following percentage or counts, e.g. '(2003 est.)', '(1998)', '(2004 est.)', or other year notations appearing after values.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These indicate the year (and sometimes that a figure is an estimate) for the reported value. Different subsections use different years; readers should treat values as time-stamped by these qualifiers when comparing across countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: AM radio station counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines like 'AM 21' or 'AM 260 (including 10 inactive stations)' appear under country headers in the 'Radio broadcast stations' section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the count of AM radio broadcast stations for the country. Some entries add qualifiers such as 'including inactive stations' or 'NA' when unknown. Example: 'Argentina  AM 260 (including 10 inactive stations) (1998)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: FM radio station counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines like 'FM 23' or 'FM 345' appear under country headers in the 'Radio broadcast stations' section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the count of FM radio broadcast stations. Counts may include repeaters or be approximations; some entries specify 'NA' or give additional context (languages broadcast, number of repeaters). Example: 'Australia  AM 262, FM 345, shortwave 1 (1998)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: shortwave radio station counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Lines like 'shortwave 1' or 'shortwave 161' appear under country headers in the 'Radio broadcast stations' section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the number of shortwave broadcast stations. Some entries note multiple frequencies/transmitters per shortwave station or indicate inactivity. Example: 'Bolivia  AM 171, FM 73, shortwave 77 (1999)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: radio_broadcast_notes (languages, inactive, repeaters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inline notes attached to radio entries such as '(broadcasts in Pashtu, Afghan Persian (Dari), Urdu, and English)', 'including 10 inactive stations', 'note: the shortwave station may be inactive', or 'includes repeaters'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides qualifiers about the radio counts: languages of broadcast, whether stations are inactive, and whether counts include repeaters. These notes affect interpretation of station counts and coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: television broadcast station counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Country lines in the 'Television broadcast stations' section listing counts (e.g., 'Australia 104 (1997)', 'China 3,240 (1997)'). Many entries include counts of repeaters in parentheses or in adjacent text ('plus 444 repeaters').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives the number of television broadcast stations for the country and frequently indicates additional repeaters. Some countries list NA or note that cable/satellite carry programming. Example: 'France 584 (plus 9,676 repeaters) (1995)'.

rubrics_metrics.name: television_repeaters / repeater_counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Phrases like 'plus 444 repeaters', 'plus 1,000 repeaters', or 'plus many low-power repeaters' accompany television station counts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates additional transmitter/repeater infrastructure beyond the main television station count. Repeaters materially increase broadcast reach; the dataset distinguishes primary station counts from repeaters.

rubrics_metrics.name: television_notes (cable/satellite/coverage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Inline notes about television coverage such as 'note - does not include repeaters; sum of individual country television broadcast stations', 'note - cable TV also available', or 'receives broadcasts from the UK and satellite'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Qualifiers on television entries clarify scope (whether repeaters included), cable/satellite availability, and special reception circumstances for territories.

rubrics_metrics.name: NA (not available) marker
rubrics_metrics.description: The string 'NA' appears for many data points (e.g., 'agriculture: NA', 'AM NA').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that the particular datum is not available or was not reported for that country/field. Users should not treat 'NA' as zero; treat as missing data.

rubrics_metrics.name: aggregate_world_entry
rubrics_metrics.description: Occasional aggregate lines such as 'World  agriculture: 4%  industry: 32%  services: 64% (2004 est.)' or 'World  AM NA, FM NA, shortwave NA'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides global aggregate percentages/counts where present. Years attached to these aggregates indicate the time of the global estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: geographic_or_political_notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Footnote-like lines such as 'note: includes West Bank', 'note: information for US bases only', or 'note - sum of individual country radio broadcast stations; there is also a European-wide station (Euroradio)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These notes clarify geographic scope, territorial inclusion, or aggregation methods and should be consulted when interpreting country-level values for disputed/complex territories or regional aggregates.

rubrics_metrics.name: page_update_timestamp
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements like 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the page's last update date; useful for assessing currency of the compiled values and for deciding whether figures are out-of-date relative to a user's needs.
